Wisp CSS

Customizing

Wisp does not ship with a settings file by design. Instead, it uses sensible defaults that you can overwrite when you are ready to make it your own.

:root {
	--wisp-color-primary: 		#111111;
	--wisp-color-primary-text: 	#ffffff;
}

Property Default Value
